sources.title: EU Data Act — article index, Article 1 (Subject matter and scope) and Article 50 (Entry into force and application)
sources.note: Privately published reproduction of Regulation (EU) 2023/2854, not an official text; the article index and the Art. 1 and Art. 50 pages (Data_Act_Article_N.html) read on 2026-09-26. Index: Chapter VI 'Switching between data processing services' is Arts. 23-31 (nine articles); the Regulation has fifty. Art. 1(2): covers personal and non-personal data. Art. 1(5): without prejudice to data-protection law; in a conflict, Union or national data-protection law prevails. Art. 50: applies from 12 September 2025; Art. 3(1) applies to connected products and related services placed on the market after 12 September 2026; Chapter IV applies to contracts concluded after 12 September 2025, and from 12 September 2027 to contracts concluded on or before that date if of indefinite duration or due to expire at least 10 years from 11 January 2024.
